name: The Juicy Blue U-Pick Berry Farm
description: The Juicy Blue U-Pick Berry Farm is a working farm in 206 Methodist Rd., OR. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
